item.title: Trivy was compromised twice in 2026. How a shared GitLab CI template for 90+ teams should run security scanners
item.description: Trivy compromised in 2026 shows why a shared GitLab CI template must pin scanners by digest, mirror images and DBs into Nexus, and verify signatures.

item.title: Proxmox Terraform with bpg: 5 LXC containers, 6 cloud-init VMs and the state drift I caused myself
item.description: bpg/proxmox Terraform provider in a real homelab on Proxmox VE 9: least-privilege API token, LXC, cloud-init VMs, import blocks, targeted applies, CI.

item.title: Air-gapped Nexus: delivering GPG-signed packages into a bank's closed network
item.description: How packages get into an air gapped Nexus repository: sign on the connected side, verify before upload, keep an audit trail. Pattern, Python gate, Nexus API.
